reserveReview.rationale: The latest report linked by the issuer on November 15 covers August 31 2026. Its management schedule reports COP 7,057,743,676.39 entirely as cash in bank accounts, with zero in the separate cash-equivalents and short-term-deposits category, against 6,768,005,179.37 COPM. BDO AUDIT S.A.S. BIC performed an ISAE 3000 limited-assurance engagement, comparing bank statements with the management schedule and token circulation on Polygon, Solana and Celo. Management signed October 6; BDO signed October 19. The bank-deposit category therefore represents 100% of the reported reserve book at that checkpoint, without implying current balances, named institutions, withdrawal terms, legal segregation or a financial-statement audit. The legacy low risk tier describes nominal fiat bank deposits; unknown bank credit, concentration and legal safeguards remain explicit in the structured fields.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: BDO-reviewed August 31 2026 management reserve schedule: COP 7,057,743,676.39 in bank accounts divided by the same total reserves
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete reported asset category is bank deposits; bank identities, institution weights, withdrawal terms, account jurisdiction, segregation, bankruptcy remoteness and rehypothecation restrictions are undisclosed. No unidentified asset-class residual is reported.
